prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective of someone walking through a snowy forest at night along the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the crunching sound of snow underfoot as the person navigates the uneven terrain. The surrounding trees stand tall and dark against the night sky, their branches heavy with snow, creating a dense canopy overhead. As the individual progresses, the camera angle shifts slightly, revealing more of the trail's surface, which is covered in a thick layer of fresh snow, interspersed with patches of exposed earth and rocks. The dim light from an unseen source casts long shadows, adding depth and contrast to the scene. The camera pans upward, showing the vast expanse of the night sky, dotted with falling snowflakes that catch the faint light, creating a serene and almost ethereal atmosphere. The person continues their journey, passing by colorful prayer flags fluttering gently in the cold air, their vibrant hues standing out against the monochrome landscape. The camera then focuses on a distant view of the mountains, their silhouettes barely visible in the darkness, before returning to the trail ahead, where the path winds into the distance, disappearing into the shadowy forest. The entire sequence captures the quiet solitude and natural beauty of a snowy night hike in a remote and untouched wilderness.
